The protein-level reports are globally imputed (every group valued in every run, no-biotin control included), so observation is taken from per-run precursor q-values: a group is observed in a run when >= 1 precursor has EG.Qvalue <= 0.01 and PG.Qvalue <= 0.01. name: SUCAM JHH4 carboxyl partial export
rationale: Author S13C peptide export, exact reviewed-human entry-name mapping; unmatched IDs quarantined. At least two distinct peptides with min_expectancy <0.05 across available runs. Peptide rows may include aligned XICs; per-run identifications/unique-peptide assignments unresolved. Only available biological replicates retained, no mock rows recovered. No annotation whitelist; diagnostic presence, not enrichment or replicate-reproducibility evidence.
method: Surfaceome Capture by Multiplex (SUCAM) biotinylation on intact cells (1.2 million cells per reaction): amine labeling with 2 mM EZ-Link Sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin (Pierce 21331) + 2 mM EZ-Link NHS-PEG4-biotin (Pierce 21330), 30 min 4 C, then carboxyl activation (2 mM EDC + 5 mM sulfo-NHS, pH 5.7) and labeling with 2 mM EZ-Link Amine-PEG2-biotin (Thermo 21346), 40 min 4 C, glycine quench. Vehicle (PBS) mock-labeled cells processed in parallel as the bead-background control. Lysis in modified RIPA, nuclear pellet discarded, capture on Streptavidin Magnetic Beads (Pierce 88817) 3 h to overnight, RIPA/8 M urea/2 M NaCl/AMBIC washes, on-bead Trypsin/Lys-C digestion; LFQ with biotin-vs-vehicle comparison. A separate aminooxy-biotin (periodate/aniline, alkoxyamine-PEG4-biotin, streptavidin agarose) arm was used only for method comparison.
method_source: Mol Cell Proteomics 2026, PMC13202573, Experimental Procedures
beads: Pierce Streptavidin Magnetic Beads (Thermo 88817; written '8817' in the text) for proteomics; Pierce Streptavidin Agarose Resin (20357) for western-blot pulldowns; high-capacity streptavidin agarose for the aminooxy arm
instrument: Q Exactive HF; LTQ Orbitrap Elite
cell_or_tissue: JHH4 hepatocellular carcinoma cells
sample_scope: JHH4 hepatocellular carcinoma cells

rationale: Original identification and specimen caveats retained in previous_reason.
method: Genetically encoded cell-surface proximity labeling: primary human CD8+ T cells lentivirally expressing surface-displayed LaccID (an O2-dependent laccase evolved from an ancestral fungal laccase; active selectively at the plasma membrane) were labeled live with 250 uM biotin-methoxyphenol (BMP) for 2 h at 37 C, quenched with 10 mM sodium ascorbate / 5 mM Trolox; 40 million cells per sample (LaccID-only T cells for the monoculture arm used here; TCR- or CAR-expressing T cells cocultured 24 h with A375 tumor cells at 3:1 for the other arms). Labeling is radical-mediated (phenoxyl radical on Tyr), so proteins near the surface enzyme are tagged whether or not they are glycosylated.
